what_happened: A docs job to add a seeded ontology file (docs/ontology.toml) with a structure test and a decision record was rejected at final verification. The verifier raised one major finding. The "Hermes" term defines only Hermes Agent and says Hermes is "not part of Athena". The governing Olympus brief also names Hermes as its Orchestration god. So the file would cause the misread it was written to prevent. No acceptance criterion is listed as unmet and no check is listed as failed.
cause: The job's checks covered the file's structure (the structure test) but not whether each term's content is right against the sources it summarizes. A term with several senses, here Hermes as both a tool and a named role, was defined from one sense. Nothing made the builder find every mention of the term in the governing documents before writing the definition. The only comparison against the Olympus brief was the final verifier's, after all the work was done.
prevention: Add a check, run before handover, that for each ontology term searches the governing docs (the Olympus brief and the other named sources) for the term's name. It fails unless the entry lists every sense found there, or records why a hit is excluded. The ontology schema should carry a sources field per term, and the structure test should require it. Each term's claims about what is "not part of Athena" must be backed by a source citation. The builder runs this check and attaches its output as evidence.
proposed_request: Fix docs/ontology.toml so that the Hermes term covers every sense used in the governing Olympus brief. That means Hermes Agent, and Hermes as the Orchestration god. State clearly which sense is part of Athena and which is not, and cite the source for each. Then check every other term the same way. Search the Olympus brief and the other governing docs for each term name, and make sure each entry covers all senses found there or records why a hit is excluded. Add a per-term sources field and extend the structure test to require it and to fail when a term name appears in a governing doc but is not covered by its entry. Update the decision record to describe this cross-check. Acceptance: the structure test passes, the Hermes entry names both senses with citations, and the change includes the search output for all terms with each excluded hit justified.
